title: TuxRoguelikeDevKitMCP
description: Unique Developer Toolset & Game Master MCP Schema for Roguelike Non-Vision Spatial Awareness and Real-Time Combat / Boss Orchestration.

tools.name: game_get_radar
tools.description: Generate an ASCII radar grid map centered on Tux the player. Allows the LLM to 'see without vision' with precise tile coordinates, walls (#), open floors (.), enemies (e), commanders (E), bosses (B), chests (C), terminals (T), portals (O), and environmental hazards (~).

width.description: Width of radar grid in tiles (default 41)

height.description: Height of radar grid in tiles (default 21)

tools.name: game_get_tactical_overview
tools.description: Retrieve comprehensive non-vision tactical semantic breakdown: player health/armor/energy, weapons held, top ranked threats by Euclidean distance & LoS, active boss telemetry, and realm mutation status.

tools.name: game_command_enemy
tools.description: Directly command any enemy or boss by name or index. Actions: ATTACK, RETREAT, HOLD, STUN, OVERHEAT (force stagger window), KILL.

tools.name: game_command_all_enemies
tools.description: Issue collective command to all living enemies in the active realm: ALL_CHARGE (rush player), ALL_RETREAT (back away), CEASE_FIRE (pause attack timers), FREEZE_ALL (shock stun horde).

tools.name: game_mutate_enemy
tools.description: Modify the runtime stats of any hostile entity (HP, maxHp, speed, shield).

tools.name: game_force_boss_phase
tools.description: Force a boss into a specific combat phase: ENRAGE (boost speed & fire rate) or OVERHEAT/VULNERABLE (open weakpoint with 2.5x critical multiplier).

boss.description: Boss identifier or empty for current active boss

tools.name: game_warp_realm
tools.description: Warp player instantly to any realm or Act: EMERALD_FRONTIER, THERMAL_FOUNDRY, CRYO_GLACIER, TOXIC_HEAP, WALLED_GARDEN, QUANTUM_VOID, TREASURE_VAULT.

tools.name: game_grant_buff
tools.description: Grant player passive buffs: SHIELD_GATE_NO_OVERFLOW (absorbs 100% of shield breaking hit), SHOTGUN_BUFF (+2 projectiles), BOUNCE_BUFF, ELEMENTAL_CRIT_DOUBLE_DMG, MELEE_REFLECT, VAMPIRE_LIFESTEAL, STATUE_PALADIN, STATUE_BERSERKER, STATUE_ELF.

duration.description: Duration in seconds (omit for permanent during run)

tools.name: game_give_weapon
tools.description: Equip weapon from WEAPON_CATALOG into Tux's active slot: 'BREAKER SHOTGUN', 'INDOMITUS BOLTER', 'SUDO MINIGUN', 'NANO CYBER-KATANA', 'AMR ANTI-MATERIEL SNIPER', 'SINGULARITY VORTEX CANNON', 'CHAINSWORD OF LIBERTY', etc.

tools.name: game_set_attack_tokens
tools.description: Dynamically adjust max attack tokens in AttackTokenPool (default 4) to control combat density and pacing.

tools.name: game_trigger_hitstop
tools.description: Trigger a freeze frame hitstop for dramatic combat juice (e.g. 0.05s).

tools.name: game_spawn_boss
tools.description: Spawn a specific boss at coordinates (or near player if omitted): ballmer_bot, patent_troll_sovereign, drm_sentinel_tank, oracle_audit_archon, apple_garden_warden, quantum_hypervisor.

tools.name: game_inject_comms
tools.description: Broadcast narrator, commander, or boss voice lines into the comms radio banner.
